quality_scale.2: functional narrow implementation with significant gaps
quality_scale.3: bounded integration verified with representative local fixtures
quality_scale.5: well-tested production operation across declared environments

interpretation: Quality is scoped to the stated capability, not a security/coverage guarantee. No score 4 or 5 is assigned from mere code presence. External runtimes not provisioned remain unverified.

requirements.recommendation: Preserve the current application and installable offline core
requirements.rationale: Use the exact delivered 4.1.0 ZIP, not an older patch tree. Keep locked core dependencies and all baseline file paths.
requirements.verification: Baseline install + 41 groups; archive install + complete release suite

requirements.recommendation: One normalized finding store with extensible metadata
requirements.rationale: SQLite and extra_json already work. New analyzers use the same persistence boundary. Not every legacy rule has a uniform rich schema.
requirements.verification: Source inspection; existing regression suite only

requirements.recommendation: Reuse established scanners instead of rebuilding all engines
requirements.rationale: Existing scanner adapters/imports are retained. A catalog entry does not mean installation, execution or validated detection.
requirements.verification: Source inspection; existing regression suite only

requirements.recommendation: Capability status distinguishes native, adapter, import and proposal
requirements.rationale: Retain the 16 earlier capabilities and register six new bounded capabilities. Model readiness is a separate check.
requirements.verification: Registry validation and existing capability tests

requirements.recommendation: Distributed scanner workers and task queues
requirements.rationale: Requires authenticated worker contracts, cancellation, durable queue semantics and multi-tenant isolation. No evidence of need on the stated local hardware.
requirements.verification: Source inspection; existing regression suite only

requirements.recommendation: Docker isolation for every scanner
requirements.rationale: Some controlled firmware execution has container contracts. Ordinary native commands are not universally containerized; Docker alone is not a complete sandbox.
requirements.verification: Source inspection; existing regression suite only

requirements.recommendation: MCP-based unrestricted autonomous tool execution
requirements.rationale: Existing typed plans/adapters provide a limited execution boundary. Do not connect arbitrary model text to a shell or expose all tools through a new server.
requirements.verification: Source inspection; existing regression suite only

requirements.recommendation: Linux cgroup v2 memory/CPU limits
requirements.rationale: Resource monitoring and subprocess deadlines exist. They are not equivalent to delegated cgroup limits; deployment support and failure semantics need design.
requirements.verification: Source inspection; existing regression suite only

requirements.recommendation: SQLite-backed graph instead of mandatory Neo4j
requirements.rationale: Use dependency-free typed exports and candidate groups; no new graph service is required. GraphML/STIX support already exists in the entity graph.
requirements.verification: Graph and end-to-end operator-view cases

requirements.recommendation: Current tool and standard catalogs imply complete coverage
requirements.rationale: Catalog size, checklist entries and taxonomy counts are inventories, not executed security tests or coverage percentages.
requirements.verification: Source inspection; existing regression suite only

requirements.recommendation: Loopback-only local Ollama with no cloud fallback
requirements.rationale: Existing client ignores proxy environment, rejects redirects and redacts model input. No model weights are redistributed.
requirements.verification: Existing local-client tests + loopback model HTTP workflow

requirements.recommendation: Refute-first review of candidate findings
requirements.rationale: Opt-in sequential counterevidence review with exact finding IDs and supplied evidence references. All verdicts remain advisory.
requirements.verification: Refutation schema/ID/citation cases + CLI model fixture

requirements.recommendation: Cross-file source context retrieval
requirements.rationale: Read the recorded source location and one-hop local Python imports only. Confine paths, reject symlinks, cap bytes and redact excerpts. This is not whole-project semantic RAG.
requirements.verification: Import, path traversal, symlink, redaction and partial-context tests

requirements.recommendation: Advisory LLM suggestions must not become authoritative CWE/CVSS
requirements.rationale: Store suggestions inside non-authoritative enrichment rather than filling main classification fields. Keep the general storage API for explicit human/tool enrichment.
requirements.verification: Stored severity/class/CWE unchanged under model response fixture

requirements.recommendation: Strict response binding to the current batch
requirements.rationale: Reject boolean/non-integer, duplicate and foreign IDs; record omissions and required-mode failures.
requirements.verification: Foreign/duplicate/omitted ID cases; required-mode failure checks

requirements.recommendation: LLM agreement or a failed reproduction confirms/refutes a bug
requirements.rationale: Model agreement is not independent captured proof. Failed reproduction, timeout and unavailable context remain unresolved, not false-positive verdicts.
requirements.verification: Source inspection; existing regression suite only

requirements.recommendation: Automatically discard model-identified false positives
requirements.rationale: Conflicts with the master prompt and cautious blueprint. Preserve findings and show counterevidence for operator review.
requirements.verification: Source inspection; existing regression suite only

requirements.recommendation: Use small and large models as a confidence cascade
requirements.rationale: No calibrated routing threshold or measured local accuracy. Sequential single-model advice fits current resource constraints better.
requirements.verification: Source inspection; existing regression suite only

requirements.recommendation: Parallel multi-agent debate/Mixture-of-Agents
requirements.rationale: Would multiply memory and latency without an independent quality evaluation. A paper result is not a guarantee for this tool or model.
requirements.verification: Source inspection; existing regression suite only

requirements.recommendation: Persistent operator feedback and learned memories
requirements.rationale: Existing lesson/proposal approval and audit storage provide a foundation. Feedback is advisory; no forever-applied automatic suppression is added.
requirements.verification: Source inspection; existing regression suite only

requirements.recommendation: Hash provenance, trust boundaries and prompt injection resistance
requirements.rationale: Bind excerpts to local file manifests and source IDs. Treat comments/findings as data; no tool calls exist. Prompt instructions alone do not establish general model robustness.
requirements.verification: Injected comment retained as data; citation/path boundary tests

requirements.recommendation: Vector RAG with Milvus/Chroma and continuous internet ingestion
requirements.rationale: Existing portable index and operator-ingested resources are retained. Automatic arbitrary research ingestion would need licensing, provenance and trust review.
requirements.verification: Source inspection; existing regression suite only

requirements.recommendation: 14B/32B default models on an 8GB GPU in a constrained VM
requirements.rationale: VM RAM, KV cache, host headroom, GPU passthrough and quantization determine feasibility. Keep the existing small-model setting and bounded context; no actual model benchmark was run.
requirements.verification: Source inspection; existing regression suite only

requirements.recommendation: Inference engines vLLM/SGLang/TensorRT and MTP/speculative decoding
requirements.rationale: Research-engine comparisons do not establish a compatible or efficient local deployment. Preserve the existing tested Ollama API boundary.
requirements.verification: Source inspection; existing regression suite only

requirements.recommendation: LLM-generated payloads, scanner templates or automatic attack execution
requirements.rationale: No automatic model-to-execution path is added. Existing typed plan/import modes remain available within their current contracts.
requirements.verification: Source inspection; existing regression suite only

requirements.recommendation: Advisory report writing and deduplication hints
requirements.rationale: Report summaries and hints are non-authoritative enrichment. Model-suggested duplicates never delete findings.
requirements.verification: Stored enrichment and operator-queue workflow tests

requirements.recommendation: 89–91% false-positive reduction applies to TBHM
requirements.rationale: Primary papers report results on their own tools, models and datasets. The local regression corpus is not a replication or an estimate of bounty precision.
requirements.verification: Source inspection; existing regression suite only

requirements.recommendation: Composite confidence weights are calibrated probabilities
requirements.rationale: Existing heuristic scores are retained for prioritization. No calibrated probability, universal threshold or precision promise is claimed.
requirements.verification: Source inspection; existing regression suite only

requirements.recommendation: Measure precision/recall and unresolved coverage honestly
requirements.rationale: Explicit labels and predictions, per-category confusion counts, undefined denominators and unresolved/missing predictions.
requirements.verification: Exact confusion-matrix and malformed-label tests; 18-case regression corpus

requirements.recommendation: Reviewed program scope, prohibited actions, methods and rate limits
requirements.rationale: Policy and explicit scope remain fail closed at request and finding boundaries. Imported ownership hints do not grant authorization.
requirements.verification: Existing policy/HTTP/proof boundary groups

requirements.recommendation: Separate observed, owned, in-scope and actively authorized assets
requirements.rationale: Graph nodes leave ownership/active permission unknown or not inferred. Stored scope decisions remain independent of observed-host grouping.
requirements.verification: Graph permission-unknown and canonical-host cases

requirements.recommendation: Automatic HackerOne/Bugcrowd/Intigriti program import
requirements.rationale: Reviewed local policy/workspace inputs already work. Provider-specific synchronization needs current APIs, account access, change reconciliation and tests.
requirements.verification: Source inspection; existing regression suite only

requirements.recommendation: Strict redirects, TLS, proxies, budgets and passive/offline boundaries
requirements.rationale: Migrate Web3 GETs to the shared broker and block early offline setup/pull combinations. Native Requests coverage does not imply a quota on child-scanner traffic.
requirements.verification: Web3 offline guard + real HTTP/redirect/TLS/proxy regression cases

requirements.recommendation: 429/503 backoff and stop controls
requirements.rationale: Shared host cooldown honors bounded Retry-After without retries or long blocking sleeps. Child scanners and browsers retain their own controls.
requirements.verification: Real loopback 429/503 responses block a second adapter before dispatch

requirements.recommendation: Passive CT/DNS/subdomain and historical URL discovery
requirements.rationale: Existing recon pipelines remain; upstream provider access, credentials and external-tool versions were not live tested.
requirements.verification: Source inspection; existing regression suite only

requirements.recommendation: Wildcard DNS resolution and duplicate normalization
requirements.rationale: Target wildcard matching is distinct from wildcard DNS noise handling. Do not equate a suffix match with resolved ownership or live coverage.
requirements.verification: Source inspection; existing regression suite only

requirements.recommendation: Technology fingerprints, live URLs and screenshots
requirements.rationale: Existing modules provide surface evidence; browser/runtime availability and third-party fingerprints require separate operational validation.
requirements.verification: Source inspection; existing regression suite only

requirements.recommendation: JavaScript, source maps and hidden endpoint collection
requirements.rationale: Keep the prior JS/source-map and source/mobile endpoint correlation work. Extracted hosts remain candidates until scope permits use.
requirements.verification: Existing JS/remediation/source-correlation regression groups

requirements.recommendation: Soft-404 and catch-all noise rejection
requirements.rationale: Remove status-only and broad hex-normalization suppression, require body equality, and reset calibration per run. Dynamic catch-all baselines can remain inconclusive.
requirements.verification: Different same-status bodies and existing baseline tests

requirements.recommendation: Continuous scan scheduling and cross-run surface diffs
requirements.rationale: Resume fingerprints and binary diff support exist. They are not a continuous asset-monitoring service or full endpoint-change tracker.
requirements.verification: Source inspection; existing regression suite only

requirements.recommendation: Cloud buckets, IAM and public configuration review
requirements.rationale: Static imports and existing read-only checks are retained. A named bucket or public empty resource is not automatically an eligible vulnerability.
requirements.verification: Source inspection; existing regression suite only

requirements.recommendation: Historical DNS/certificate/provider-based origin hypotheses
requirements.rationale: Existing collectors can produce DNS/fingerprint leads. No calibrated origin-attribution engine or validated CDN-bypass verifier is present.
requirements.verification: Source inspection; existing regression suite only

requirements.recommendation: Direct Host/SNI origin verification
requirements.rationale: Requires separate IP authorization, SNI/Host compatibility, body/certificate controls and negative baselines. A matching favicon or certificate does not prove ownership.
requirements.verification: Source inspection; existing regression suite only

requirements.recommendation: Origin score 60% HTTP,25% certificate,15% favicon
requirements.rationale: Weights are unvalidated heuristics. Do not publish a percentage certainty or promote an origin based on this formula.
requirements.verification: Source inspection; existing regression suite only

requirements.recommendation: ASN/CIDR and neighbor /24 expansion
requirements.rationale: Nearby addresses, ASN membership and a wildcard domain are not permission to probe an IP range. Existing explicit network scope remains required.
requirements.verification: Source inspection; existing regression suite only

requirements.recommendation: WAF fingerprints and permitted request parsing checks
requirements.rationale: Existing opt-in checks remain. WAF bypass is context dependent and was not validated against production edge devices in this release.
requirements.verification: Source inspection; existing regression suite only

requirements.recommendation: Universal stealth/IP rotation or aggressive evasion defaults
requirements.sources: R2 §12.2; R5 §4; R6 WAF section; R7 §7
requirements.rationale: Program policy, identification and rate ceilings remain authoritative; there is no evidence that stealth or automatic proxy rotation is generally permitted or improves quality.
requirements.verification: Source inspection; existing regression suite only

requirements.recommendation: Python intra-procedural source-to-sink analysis
requirements.rationale: Add reassignment kills, conservative branch/loop/exception joins, nested source expressions and subprocess shell semantics. Does not prove path feasibility or model every Python construct.
requirements.verification: 18 selected snippets + overwrite/branch/shell and source workflow tests

requirements.recommendation: Sink-specific sanitizer handling and mitigation evidence
requirements.rationale: Stop considering arbitrary escape/validate words as sanitizers. Numeric conversion on the whole tracked value is the narrow modeled control; other control contexts remain review leads.
requirements.verification: HTML-to-SQL/shell, unrelated escape and numeric controls

requirements.recommendation: Bind AST flow to the correct sink/CWE/location
requirements.rationale: Match the sink line and CWE, retain source file/line/function metadata for context. File-level route reachability is still supporting context, not runtime sink proof.
requirements.verification: Source inspection; existing regression suite only

requirements.recommendation: Full semantic JavaScript/TypeScript taint analysis
requirements.decision: fix false mitigation; defer semantic engine
requirements.rationale: Lexical tracking remains explicitly approximate. Do not mark a sink mitigated simply because encodeURIComponent or a sanitizer word appears on the line.
requirements.verification: Lexical HTML encoding counterexample

requirements.recommendation: Cross-file interprocedural analysis for all source languages
requirements.rationale: Existing reverse-IR taint and bounded source excerpts are not a whole-project Python/JS/Java/Go call-graph taint engine.
requirements.verification: Source inspection; existing regression suite only

requirements.recommendation: Semgrep/CodeQL/Bandit multi-language adapters
requirements.rationale: Existing adapter/import code is retained; no local installations or real CodeQL databases were available for validating all languages.
requirements.verification: Source inspection; existing regression suite only

requirements.recommendation: Dependency SBOM and advisory enrichment
requirements.rationale: Native local SBOM generation stays offline. OSV metadata is opt-in and never a substitute for version/reachability analysis.
requirements.verification: Source inspection; existing regression suite only

requirements.recommendation: Secret detection, placeholders, redaction and reversible review
requirements.rationale: Existing dummy/example gates and redacted drop archive remain. A string pattern alone does not establish live credentials.
requirements.verification: Existing secret, runner, storage and delivery redaction groups

requirements.recommendation: Live validation of discovered credentials
requirements.rationale: Existing optional verifier behavior is retained, but API acceptance alone is not a strict proof contract for all credential classes; no live keys were exercised.
requirements.verification: Source inspection; existing regression suite only

requirements.recommendation: IaC, CI/CD, supply-chain and signing review
requirements.rationale: Existing native imports and configured adapters are retained; not every IaC provider or pipeline rule is natively implemented.
requirements.verification: Source inspection; existing regression suite only

requirements.recommendation: Business logic and authorization inferred from source names
requirements.rationale: Source route/auth/payment pattern branches guide review. Names and missing-looking decorators do not prove an authorization or workflow failure.
requirements.verification: Source inspection; existing regression suite only

requirements.recommendation: Binary IR, symbols, taint and source/binary correlation
requirements.rationale: Existing reverse-analysis contracts and imports remain; stripped binaries and arbitrary architectures do not receive universal precision guarantees.
requirements.verification: Source inspection; existing regression suite only

requirements.recommendation: Benign differential verification with negative controls and repeats
requirements.rationale: Strict v2 proof classes currently cover access control, sensitive data exposure and open redirect. Other classes remain leads without a supported proof contract.
requirements.verification: Existing authenticated capture/proof acceptance/tampering groups

requirements.recommendation: Replayable reports, captured requests and reproducer kits
requirements.rationale: Curls and scanner prose are reproducibility aids; a generated request is not a successful PoC. Final redacted artifacts and SQLite backup are sealed.
requirements.verification: Report and sealed snapshot tests

requirements.recommendation: Offline OpenAPI/Swagger intake with inherited security and parameters
requirements.rationale: Extend the existing spec phase. Support bounded Swagger 2.0/OpenAPI 3.0/3.1, local parameter/request-body refs and root/operation security semantics. Never follow remote refs.
requirements.verification: Inheritance, empty overrides, OR-anonymous, local ref and malformed input tests

requirements.recommendation: API operation/security/schema change review
requirements.rationale: Compare operations, security, parameter/body structures and shared-schema hashes. Full JSON Schema semantic equivalence and breaking-change reasoning are not implemented.
requirements.verification: Operation removal/security and shared-schema change cases

requirements.recommendation: Compare declared APIs with HAR observations
requirements.rationale: Method/path/declared-host and server-prefix matches only. No token/body copying or replay, no assumption that an observed endpoint was security tested.
requirements.verification: Declared-host, route-template and base-prefix HAR tests

requirements.recommendation: Published API documentation itself is a vulnerability
requirements.rationale: Machine-readable documentation is an INFO surface observation. Intent and sensitive contents require separate evidence.
requirements.verification: Source change and full CLI workflow

requirements.recommendation: Authenticated multi-role BOLA/BFLA/tenant comparisons
requirements.rationale: Offline role matrices and explicit proof contracts exist. A general autonomous stateful multi-tenant API tester is not complete.
requirements.verification: Source inspection; existing regression suite only

requirements.recommendation: Stateful business workflows, races, quotas and mass assignment
requirements.rationale: Generic workflow labels cannot establish policy or safe mutation semantics. Existing limited checks and planned invariants remain.
requirements.verification: Source inspection; existing regression suite only

requirements.recommendation: GraphQL introspection, authorization, batching and complexity
requirements.rationale: Existing probes do not provide complete resolver-level authorization or business-logic coverage; exhaustion/DoS checks are not added.
requirements.verification: Source inspection; existing regression suite only

requirements.recommendation: OAuth/OIDC/JWT, WebSockets and modern browser security
requirements.rationale: Retain existing modules and policy gates. Full federation, token lifecycle and protocol-state testing require dedicated fixtures.
requirements.verification: Source inspection; existing regression suite only

requirements.recommendation: OOB SSRF/XXE confirmation and callback infrastructure
requirements.rationale: No external collaborator service was provisioned. A callback alone needs request correlation, negative controls and authorized external interaction handling.
requirements.verification: Source inspection; existing regression suite only

requirements.recommendation: Schemathesis schema-conformance fuzzing
requirements.rationale: Existing opt-in invocation is retained but its upstream CLI compatibility and actual fuzzing were not validated. New contract intake does not automatically fuzz imported specs.
requirements.verification: Source inspection; existing regression suite only

requirements.recommendation: Safe APK/IPA extraction and string/endpoint intake
requirements.rationale: Archive containment/size controls and native string discovery remain. No device or emulator is required for static intake.
requirements.verification: Existing archive/manifest groups + combined source/mobile workflow

requirements.recommendation: Structured exported components, permissions, SDK and deep links
requirements.rationale: Permission inheritance, explicit enabled/exported values, provider read/write permissions and URI/path markers. Defaults/resources stay unknown; no blanket exported-component vulnerability.
requirements.verification: Permission/signature, disabled, unknown SDK/exported and source XML tests

requirements.recommendation: Android application settings and network-security policy
requirements.rationale: Explicit booleans remain verified declarations. networkSecurityConfig is identified but referenced XML resources, effective backup policy and runtime traffic are not fully resolved.
requirements.verification: Source inspection; existing regression suite only

requirements.recommendation: Binary AXML component semantics without a decoder
requirements.rationale: Existing AAPT boolean support is retained. Component inventory is explicitly incomplete without decoded XML instead of guessing from strings.
requirements.verification: Source inspection; existing regression suite only

requirements.recommendation: iOS ATS, URL schemes, keychain, entitlements and local storage
requirements.rationale: ATS/plist/string checks and imports are not a full iOS storage, entitlement or keychain security assessment.
requirements.verification: Source inspection; existing regression suite only

requirements.recommendation: MobSF static/dynamic integration
requirements.rationale: Existing adapters/import paths remain. A MobSF service and real mobile projects were not provisioned in this release.
requirements.verification: Source inspection; existing regression suite only

requirements.recommendation: Frida/Objection, pinning bypass and runtime instrumentation
requirements.rationale: Keep existing proposal/import/tooling paths. No claim that device instrumentation, pinning bypass or exploit execution has been tested.
requirements.verification: Source inspection; existing regression suite only

requirements.recommendation: MASVS/MSTG mappings guarantee control compliance
requirements.rationale: Use standards as review guidance. A checklist label or exported flag is not proof of failing a MASVS control.
requirements.verification: Source inspection; existing regression suite only

requirements.recommendation: Firmware extraction, SBOM, credentials and unsafe library inventory
requirements.rationale: Existing bounded static and import workflows remain. Binary strings, default credential patterns or unsafe function imports do not prove exploitable memory corruption.
requirements.verification: Source inspection; existing regression suite only

requirements.recommendation: EMBA and RouterSploit capability integration
requirements.rationale: Retain EMBA static adapter/imports and isolated-mode contracts. RouterSploit catalog/import does not imply autonomous exploit execution.
requirements.verification: Earlier installer/firmware/import regression groups

requirements.recommendation: QEMU/FirmAE/FAT dynamic emulation and exploit proofs
requirements.rationale: CPU architecture, kernel, NVRAM, network services and hardware peripherals need target-specific work. No universal emulator or runtime vulnerability claim is added.
requirements.verification: Source inspection; existing regression suite only

requirements.recommendation: MQTT/CoAP/UPnP/BLE/Zigbee protocol testing
requirements.rationale: Existing passive wireless import is narrow; it is not active fuzzing or coverage of all embedded protocols.
requirements.verification: Source inspection; existing regression suite only

requirements.recommendation: angr/Triton symbolic analysis and crash/fuzz triage
requirements.rationale: Existing import/harness contracts remain. Symbolic states, dangerous API names and sanitizer crashes still require exploitability review.
requirements.verification: Source inspection; existing regression suite only

requirements.recommendation: FAT is a Rust command-injection taint engine
requirements.rationale: The supplied FAT description conflates tooling roles. Do not build an integration on an unverified language/analysis claim.
requirements.verification: Source inspection; existing regression suite only

requirements.recommendation: Frontend prose, hashes and ordinary read RPC are vulnerabilities
requirements.rationale: Remove arbitrary 12-word/64-hex secret matches. Require key/seed assignment context and redact values. Read block-number/IPFS-version endpoints become INFO observations.
requirements.verification: Prose/hash/key counterexamples + offline network guard tests

requirements.recommendation: Import Slither detector JSON into actual findings/reporting
requirements.rationale: Validate success flag and record structure, bound input, deduplicate detector records, persist static leads and expose import status. No compiler/build hooks run.
requirements.verification: Error/partial/dedup/lead classification and combined CLI workflow

requirements.recommendation: Execute Slither compiler pipeline automatically
requirements.rationale: Solidity compilation and arbitrary project build hooks need a disposable environment and pinned toolchain. Import support is not live scanner execution.
requirements.verification: Source inspection; existing regression suite only

requirements.recommendation: Echidna/Medusa/Foundry invariant fuzzing and fork simulation
requirements.rationale: Requires contract-specific invariants, compiler versions, RPC/fork fixtures and budgeted harness execution. No generic confirmed oracle or flash-loan detector is claimed.
requirements.verification: Source inspection; existing regression suite only

requirements.recommendation: Mythril/Manticore symbolic contract execution
requirements.rationale: State explosion, compiler/chain semantics and validation costs exceed a trustworthy dependency-free release addition.
requirements.verification: Source inspection; existing regression suite only

requirements.recommendation: Solidity/Vyper/Rust/Move/Cairo universal analysis
requirements.rationale: Do not substitute generic regex scans for language-specific contract semantics. Slither import covers its supported output only.
requirements.verification: Source inspection; existing regression suite only

requirements.recommendation: BIP39 seed/private-key validity and ownership validation
requirements.rationale: New assignment indicators are explicitly unvalidated. No mnemonic is logged, derived, used to access a wallet or sent to a service.
requirements.verification: Source inspection; existing regression suite only

requirements.recommendation: OWASP Smart Contract Top 10 2026 as a coverage checklist
requirements.rationale: Current primary taxonomy can guide future work. A Slither detector name or imported result is not a complete control test or universal OWASP mapping.
requirements.verification: Source inspection; existing regression suite only

requirements.recommendation: Canonical assets before correlating findings
requirements.rationale: Normalize exact host identity, prefer actual URL host, distinguish local artifacts; never merge sibling domains or infer scope from DNS/certificates.
requirements.verification: Canonical host/local file and cross-asset cases

requirements.recommendation: Co-occurrence, hypothesis and verified path remain different
requirements.rationale: Honor --chain-simulate, require distinct records on one asset, list missing preconditions and never claim a verified transition.
requirements.verification: Flag, distinct-step, cross-asset and no synthetic finding tests

requirements.recommendation: Automatically raise severity based on generated attack narratives
requirements.rationale: Do not create high/critical chain findings from title matches; exclude earlier attack_path records from inputs. Existing source findings remain intact.
requirements.verification: No synthetic findings and recursive-source exclusion cases

requirements.recommendation: Evidence-driven deduplication by root cause
requirements.rationale: Stable title-independent candidate keys suggest review. They do not delete, consolidate or prove a shared cause; site-wide authorization logic can require manual grouping.
requirements.verification: Candidate grouping preserves both record IDs

requirements.recommendation: Preconditions/postconditions and verified exploit-enables edges
requirements.rationale: The new export intentionally contains observations and candidate groups. A full capability planner or verified multi-stage path engine is not implemented.
requirements.verification: Source inspection; existing regression suite only

requirements.recommendation: MITRE ATT&CK mapping demonstrates observed adversary behavior
requirements.rationale: Navigator/maps remain conceptual keyword associations. They are not observed execution, attribution or proof; the embedded legacy taxonomy version is not presented as the latest.
requirements.verification: Source inspection; existing regression suite only

requirements.recommendation: Automated credential dumping, persistence and lateral movement chains
requirements.sources: R1 pp6–7; R4 chain example; R8 §10
requirements.rationale: Keep existing campaign governance and imported evidence; do not add autonomous credential dumping or persistence as a bounty optimization.
requirements.verification: Source inspection; existing regression suite only

requirements.recommendation: One operator view derived from persisted state
requirements.rationale: Searchable review queue, evidence state, advisory review status, real artifact links and ledger outcome counts. No simulated progress or fake coverage percentage.
requirements.verification: Combined CLI workflow, model fixture and sealed operator artifacts

requirements.recommendation: Resume detects changed input bytes and re-runs derived reporting
requirements.rationale: New flags use fingerprint-recognized input suffixes. Resume is not a continuous monitoring scheduler.
requirements.verification: Existing resume tests; contract fingerprint regression

requirements.recommendation: Target-free local source/import workflows
requirements.rationale: Correct code-repos names and compose source/mobile/API/Slither flags into one local subset. Explicit --phases remains an operator override.
requirements.verification: Combined targetless CLI workflow and repository-intent tests

requirements.recommendation: Markdown/HTML/JSON/CSV/SARIF and role-oriented reporting
requirements.rationale: Existing report formats and audience views remain. SARIF/result identifiers are not guaranteed stable across arbitrary refactoring.
requirements.verification: Existing report groups and new workflow tests

requirements.recommendation: Auto-submit to bounty platforms or messaging
requirements.rationale: Keep local evidence packages. No program report, email, chat message or external submission was sent during this work.
requirements.verification: Source inspection; existing regression suite only

requirements.recommendation: Calibrated bounty ROI, payout predictions and coverage counts
requirements.rationale: Bounty eligibility and payouts depend on each program and demonstrated impact. No 555-check, zero-FP or earnings guarantee is attached to this release.
requirements.verification: Source inspection; existing regression suite only

requirements.recommendation: Complete research inventory and duplicate/conflict assessment
requirements.rationale: All eight attachments read; PDF body overlaps the text copy, PDF includes bibliography, and the master prompt is process guidance.
requirements.verification: Attachment byte/hash register and extracted PDF text inspection

requirements.recommendation: Install, CLI, package integrity, security regressions and reproducibility
requirements.rationale: Retain earlier groups, add targeted behavioral and CLI groups, install from the final ZIP, verify pinned dependencies and exact manifest.
requirements.verification: Verification report and machine-readable final test results

requirements.recommendation: Maintain every external scanner and cross-platform integration
requirements.feasibility: multiple OS/tool services and lab assets
requirements.rationale: This distribution is tested on Linux x86-64 / Python 3.12. No claim of all optional scanner, Windows/macOS, mobile-device, firmware or blockchain integration readiness.
requirements.verification: Source inspection; existing regression suite only
